---
title: "HG cells: label transfer with Azimuth"
format: html
---

Azimuth reference built from the annotated single-cell data (including the eosinophil subclusters) and mapped onto the HG cells.

## Load library
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(Azimuth)
```

# Azimuth 
```{r}
DATA <- readRDS("data/scrna/Fig1b_sc_all.rds") 
data <- readRDS("data/scrna/Fig1e_sc_eosinophil.rds") 

DATA$Anno2 <- DATA$Anno
DATA$Anno2 [colnames(data)] <- data$New_clusters
DATA <- subset(DATA, subset=Anno2=="Eosinophil", invert = T)

DATA$Anno2 <- ifelse(
  grepl("^\\d+$", DATA$Anno2), 
  paste0("Eos", DATA$Anno2), 
  DATA$Anno2)


#DATA[['RNA']] <- split(DATA[['RNA']], f = DATA$Batch)
DATA <- SCTransform(DATA, vst.flavor = "v2")
DATA <- RunPCA(DATA)
#DATA <- IntegrateLayers(DATA, method = "HarmonyIntegration", normalization.method = "SCT")

DATA <-  RunUMAP(DATA,reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30,return.model = T)

ref <- AzimuthReference(
  object = DATA,
  refUMAP = "umap", 
  refDR = "pca", 
  metadata = c("Anno2","Anno") # The column containing your labels
)

DATA_pro <- readRDS("data/scrna/Brain_progenitor/data_inted.rds")
HG <- subset(DATA_pro, subset=Subtypes=="HG_2")

DATA <- RunAzimuth(HG, reference ="azimuth_reference/")
dir.create("azimuth_reference")

SaveAnnoyIndex(
  object = ref[["refdr.annoy.neighbors"]],
  file = file.path("azimuth_reference2", "idx.annoy")
)

SaveSeuratRds(ref, file = "azimuth_reference2/ref.rds")

DATA$predicted.Anno.score

DATA <- RunAzimuth(DATA_pro, reference = "azimuth_reference2/")

DimPlot(DATA, group.by = "predicted.Anno", label = T) 

DATA$predicted.Anno2 <- "Score less than 0.7"


```


since i see eos2, 3, 4, 5, 6 all are stacked together. I will do subset

```{r}
data <- subset(DATA_pro, subset = Subtypes=="HG_2")


Condition <- DATA@meta.data %>%
  group_by(Subtypes, predicted.Anno2) %>% # In you case you should group by "day" and "Clusters"
  summarize(nCells = n()) %>%
  group_by(Subtypes) %>% # This should be changed for "day"
  mutate(prop = nCells/sum(nCells))


ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = Condition, aes(Subtypes, prop, fill =predicted.Anno2 ), stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave("Prediction_sub.pdf", width = 7, height = 4, dpi=600)

write.csv(Condition, "prediction_sub.csv")
```

```{r}
# find all score columns
score.cols <- grep("predicted.Anno.score", colnames(DATA@meta.data), value = TRUE)

p <- DimPlot(DATA, group.by = "predicted.Anno" , reduction = "umap.cca")
df <- p$data
df$Subtypes <- DATA$Subtypes
df$`Relative Prediction Score` <- DATA$predicted.Anno.score^2
df$`Predicted Celltype` <- DATA$predicted.Anno

df$label_clean <- ifelse(df$`Prediction Score` < 0.5, "low_confidence", df$`Predicted Celltype`)
df$alpha <- df$alpha^2   # emphasize confident cells

ggplot(df, aes(x = umapcca_1, y = umapcca_2)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Subtypes, alpha = alpha),
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.1, 1)) +
  theme_classic()
```


```{r}
library(mascarade)

maskTable <- generateMask(
  dims = df[, 1:2], 
  cluster = df$Subtypes, 
  expand = 0.015
)

centroids <- df %>%
  group_by(Subtypes) %>%
  summarise(
    centroid_x = mean(umapcca_1, na.rm = TRUE),
    centroid_y = mean(umapcca_2, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
my_10_colors <- c(
  "#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3", "#FF7F00", 
  "#9590ff", "#A65628", "#F781BF", "#999999", "#66C2A5"
)
ggplot(df, aes(x = umapcca_1, y = umapcca_2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = `Predicted Celltype`, alpha = `Relative Prediction Score` ),size = 1.3) +
  geom_path(data = maskTable, aes(group = group), linewidth = 0.6, linetype = 2) +
  #coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_10_colors) +
  theme_classic()+
  #scale_color_manual(values = colorRampPalette(fixed_colors)(36))+
  tidydr::theme_dr(xlength = 0.22, ylength = 0.22, arrow = grid::arrow(length = unit(0.15, "inches"), type = "closed"))+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())+ 
  geom_text(data = centroids, aes(label = Subtypes, x = centroid_x, y = centroid_y), 
                   size = 3.5, vjust = -2.5, hjust = -0.2,
                   color = "black", fontface = "bold")

ggsave("Prediction2.pdf", width = 7, height = 4, dpi=600)

```
